name: orion-desktop
description: ORION — Sovereign Intelligence OS (aplikasi desktop Windows, macOS, dan Linux)
author: DIGIUM

scripts.test: node scripts/selftest.js && node scripts/test-connectors.js && node scripts/test-webtools.js && node scripts/test-extract.js && node scripts/test-bridge.js && node scripts/test-mission-runtime.js && node scripts/test-phase3.js && node scripts/test-phase3-hardening.js && node scripts/test-phase4.js && node scripts/test-phase5.js && node scripts/scan-secrets.js
scripts.build:win:installer: npm run prepare:app && cross-env ORION_TARGET=installer electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.build:win:portable: npm run prepare:app && cross-env ORION_TARGET=portable electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.build:win:all: npm run build:win:installer && npm run build:win:portable && npm run verify:release && npm run release:finalize
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.mobile:build:ios: cd mobile/ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace ORION.xcworkspace -scheme ORION -configuration Release
